title: Invoice items list
description: Canonical PascalCase JSON representation of a complete ordered application-level invoice item list. This aggregate is not an independently encoded INVOICE ITEMS by square QR block and never contains FirstInvoiceLineID. Decimal values are lossless canonical strings.
$comment: Properties marked readOnly are bsqr:computed=true and are not transported in QR sequences. Every bsqr:maxLength annotation is advisory and is recorded in descriptions instead of a rejecting JSON maxLength keyword.

InvoiceID.description: Invoice identifier shared by all source QR blocks. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

Decimal.description: Lossless canonical XSD decimal string. Transported decimal fields have advisory bsqr:maxLength 15.

Percentage.description: Canonical VAT rate in the XSD range [0,1], for example 0.2 for 20%. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

Date.description: Canonical ISO 8601 calendar date; transported as YYYYMMDD. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 8.

ItemName.description: Item name or description. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 30.

ItemEANCode.description: EAN item identifier. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 30.

UnitPriceTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed as UnitPriceTaxExclusiveAmount + UnitPriceTaxAmount; not transported.

LineTaxExclusiveAmount.description: Computed as UnitPriceTaxExclusiveAmount × InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

LineTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed as UnitPriceTaxInclusiveAmount × InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

LineTaxAmount.description: Computed as UnitPriceTaxAmount × InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

OrderID.description: Order identifier when different from the parent invoice. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

OrderLineID.description: Line identifier in the order. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

DeliveryNoteID.description: Delivery-note identifier when different from the parent invoice. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

DeliveryNoteLineID.description: Line identifier in the delivery note. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.
